<style>
  :root{
    --navy:#020617; --sky-50:#f0f9ff; --gray-50:#f9fafb; --gray-200:#e5e7eb;
    --accent:#38bdf8; --text:#0f172a; --text-soft:#475569;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  body{font-family:'Inter',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; color:var(--text); line-height:1.55; margin:0;}
  h1,h2,h3{font-family:'Space Grotesk',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; font-weight:700; line-height:1.15; margin:0;}
  .wrap{max-width:1120px; margin:0 auto; padding:0 24px;}
  .eyebrow{font-size:13px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.12em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--accent); margin-bottom:12px; display:block;}
  section{padding:96px 0;}
  .pill{display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; border-radius:999px; padding:14px 28px; font-weight:600; font-size:15px; text-decoration:none; border:2px solid transparent; cursor:pointer; transition:transform .15s ease;}
  .pill:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);}
  .pill-primary{background:var(--accent); color:var(--navy);}
  .pill-outline{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.4); color:#fff;}
  .pill-dark{background:var(--navy); color:#fff;}

  .site-header{position:sticky; top:0; z-index:40; background:rgba(255,255,255,.95); backdrop-filter:blur(8px); border-bottom:1px solid var(--gray-200);}
  .site-header .wrap{display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; padding:14px 24px;}
  .brand{display:flex; flex-direction:column; text-decoration:none; color:var(--text); line-height:1.1;}
  .brand .word{font-family:'Space Grotesk'; font-weight:700; font-size:19px;}
  .brand .word span{color:var(--accent);}
  .brand .tagline{font-size:11px; color:var(--text-soft); font-weight:500;}
  nav{display:flex; gap:28px; align-items:center;}
  nav a{color:var(--text); text-decoration:none; font-size:14px; font-weight:500;}
  nav a:hover{color:var(--accent);}
  .header-cta{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:18px;}
  .phone-link{font-weight:600; color:var(--text); text-decoration:none; font-size:14px;}
  .nav-toggle{display:none; background:none; border:0; padding:6px; font-size:22px; line-height:1; cursor:pointer; color:var(--text);}
  .header-cta .pill{white-space:nowrap;}
  @media (max-width:900px){
    nav{display:none;}
    .nav-toggle{display:inline-flex;}
    .site-header.nav-open nav{display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:16px; position:absolute; top:100%; left:0; right:0; background:#fff; border-bottom:1px solid var(--gray-200); padding:18px 24px;}
  }

  .hero{background:var(--navy); color:#fff; position:relative; overflow:hidden; padding:120px 0;}
  .hero .badge{display:inline-flex; gap:8px; align-items:center; background:rgba(255,255,255,.08); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15); border-radius:999px; padding:8px 16px; font-size:13px; margin-bottom:24px;}
  .hero h1{font-size:52px; color:#fff; max-width:820px;}
  .hero h1 .accent{color:var(--accent);}
  .hero p.lead{max-width:640px; font-size:18px; color:#cbd5e1; margin:24px 0 36px;}
  .hero .cta-row{display:flex; gap:16px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-bottom:56px;}
  .trust-row{display:flex; gap:32px; flex-wrap:wrap; border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15); padding-top:28px;}
  .trust-row div{font-size:14px; color:#e2e8f0; font-weight:500;}

  .bg-sky{background:var(--sky-50);}
  .bg-white{background:#fff;}
  .bg-gray{background:var(--gray-50); border-top:1px solid var(--gray-200); border-bottom:1px solid var(--gray-200);}
  .bg-navy{background:var(--navy); color:#fff;}
  .bg-accent{background:var(--accent);}

  .section-head{max-width:640px; margin-bottom:56px;}
  .section-head h2{font-size:36px;}
  .section-head p{color:var(--text-soft); margin-top:16px; font-size:16px;}
  .bg-navy .section-head p{color:#cbd5e1;}

  .grid{display:grid; gap:28px;}
  .grid-3{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);}
  .grid-4{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);}
  .grid-2{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}
  @media (max-width:900px){ .grid-3,.grid-4,.grid-2{grid-template-columns:1fr;} }

  .step{background:#fff; border:1px solid var(--gray-200); border-radius:16px; padding:28px;}
  .step .num{width:36px; height:36px; border-radius:999px; background:var(--navy); color:#fff; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-weight:700; margin-bottom:16px; font-family:'Space Grotesk';}
  .step h3{font-size:18px; margin-bottom:8px;}
  .step p{color:var(--text-soft); font-size:14px; margin:0;}

  .feature{padding:4px;}
  .feature .icon{font-size:28px; margin-bottom:14px;}
  .feature h3{font-size:17px; margin-bottom:8px;}
  .feature p{color:var(--text-soft); font-size:14px; margin:0;}

  .card{background:#fff; border:1px solid var(--gray-200); border-radius:16px; padding:26px;}
  .card h3{font-size:17px; margin-bottom:10px;}

  .review-card p{font-size:14px; color:var(--text-soft); margin:0 0 14px;}
  .review-card .who{font-size:13px; font-weight:600;}

  .contact-section .wrap{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:64px; align-items:start;}
  @media (max-width:900px){ .contact-section .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr;} }
  .contact-section h2{font-size:34px; color:#fff;}
  .contact-section .benefit{display:flex; gap:14px; margin-top:24px;}
  .contact-section .benefit h4{font-size:15px; margin-bottom:4px;}
  .contact-section .benefit p{font-size:14px; color:#cbd5e1; margin:0;}

  form{background:#fff; border-radius:16px; padding:28px; display:grid; gap:14px;}
  form label{font-size:13px; font-weight:600; color:var(--text); display:block; margin-bottom:6px;}
  form input, form select, form textarea{width:100%; border:1px solid var(--gray-200); border-radius:10px; padding:12px 14px; font-size:14px; font-family:inherit;}

  .cta-banner{text-align:center;}
  .cta-banner h2{font-size:34px; max-width:700px; margin:0 auto;}
  .cta-banner p{margin:16px 0 32px; font-size:16px;}
  .cta-banner .cta-row{display:flex; gap:16px; justify-content:center; flex-wrap:wrap;}

  footer{padding:80px 0 40px; background:var(--navy); color:#cbd5e1;}
  footer .grid-4{margin-bottom:56px;}
  footer h4{font-size:14px; margin-bottom:16px; color:#fff;}
  footer ul{list-style:none; margin:0; padding:0; display:grid; gap:10px;}
  footer a{color:#cbd5e1; text-decoration:none; font-size:14px;}
  footer a:hover{color:var(--accent);}
  footer p{color:#94a3b8; font-size:14px;}
  .footer-bottom{border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1); padding-top:24px; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:12px; font-size:13px; color:#94a3b8;}
  .topbar{background:var(--navy);}
  .topbar-inner{max-width:1120px; margin:0 auto; padding:7px 24px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:13px;}
  .open-status{display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; font-weight:600; color:#fff;}
  .os-dot{width:9px; height:9px; border-radius:50%; background:#4ade80; flex:none;}
  .open-status.is-open .os-dot{animation:ospulse 1.5s ease-out infinite;}
  .open-status.is-closed .os-dot{background:#94a3b8;}
  .os-text{font-weight:700; color:#4ade80;}
  .open-status.is-closed .os-text{color:#cbd5e1;}
  .os-sep{color:#64748b;}
  .os-clock{color:var(--accent); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.02em;}
  @keyframes ospulse{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(74,222,128,.7);} 70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 6px rgba(74,222,128,0);} 100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(74,222,128,0);}}
</style>
<style>

bodyHtml:
Home/About Us
About Computers Gold Coast

Your local computer repair technicians, right here on the Gold Coast.

We're a family-owned repair business, not a franchise. For 20 years we've been fixing PCs, laptops and Macs for Gold Coast homes and businesses. We find the real cause of the problem first, explain it in plain English, and tell you the price before any work starts.

Get In Touch Call 0447 266 455
✓ 20 Years' Experience
✓ Family-Owned, Not a Franchise
✓ $0 Call-Out Fee
✓ Open 7am to 10pm, 7 Days
Our Story

A family business that does the job properly

Most people only call a computer technician when something has already gone wrong, and it's rarely a good time. The laptop won't start on the morning of a deadline, or the family PC is suddenly covered in pop-ups. In that moment you want someone local, honest about the cost, and good enough to fix it the first time. That's the business we run.

Our director is a Microsoft Certified Professional who started out at IBM, as the youngest employee in Australia at the time. Twenty years on, we still work the same way we always have. You speak directly to the technician who will do your job, not a call centre or a sales rep. Along the way we've also been featured on Channel 9 news.

We come to homes and offices right across the Gold Coast with no call-out fee, fix many software problems remotely, and take drop-offs for bigger jobs. If you'd like to see everything we can help with, have a look at our full list of services.

"You deal with one local technician, from the first phone call to the finished repair."
  • 20 yearsfixing PCs, laptops and Macs
  • MicrosoftCertified Professional director
  • Channel 9featured on the news
  • 40+types of IT services
What To Expect

How we look after every customer

The same rules apply whether it's a cracked laptop screen in Southport or a small office network in Robina.

01

Not a franchise or a call centre

You talk to a local technician who knows your job, not someone reading from a script in another state.

02

No call-out fee, ever

We come to your home or office anywhere on the Gold Coast without charging you just to turn up.

03

The price before we start

We tell you what's wrong and what it will cost, and only go ahead once you've said yes. No hourly padding.

04

Straight advice, no upselling

If free, reputable software will do the job, we'll recommend it. If a repair isn't worth the money, we'll say so.

05

Onsite, remote or drop-off

Plenty of software problems can be fixed over the internet. Hardware jobs are done at your place or dropped off, whichever suits you.

06

Open 7am to 10pm, 7 days

Computers don't only break during business hours, so we're available early, late, on weekends and on public holidays.

How A Repair Works

Clear answers before you commit to a repair

One symptom can have several causes. A laptop that won't turn on might need a new charger, a new DC jack or a motherboard repair, and each one costs something very different. So we diagnose first and quote second.

1

Tell us the symptoms

Call or send a message with the make, model and what the computer is doing. A photo of any error message helps.

2

We find the cause

Onsite at your home or office, or remotely for software problems. We look for the cause, not just the symptom.

3

You approve, we fix it

You get a clear explanation and a price. Nothing starts until you're happy to go ahead.

Handy to have ready when you call

  • The make and model (usually on a sticker underneath)
  • When the problem started, and anything that changed just before
  • Any error messages, beeps or warning lights
  • Whether your files are backed up
  • The charger, if it's a laptop

Repair options depend on the model and the fault. Data recovery can't always be promised until we've looked at the drive. If a device isn't economical to repair, we can supply a report for your insurance claim.

What We Fix

Find the right service for your problem

These are the jobs Gold Coast customers ask us about most. Each page explains the common faults, how we fix them and what to expect.

Computer Repairs

Slow, crashing or dead desktop PCs, all brands.

Laptop Repairs

Screens, batteries, hinges, DC jacks and motherboards.

Mac Repairs

MacBook, iMac and Mac mini faults diagnosed and fixed.

Virus & Spyware Removal

Pop-ups, hijacked browsers and suspicious slowdowns cleaned up.

Data Recovery

Files back from failed drives, deleted folders and dead laptops.

WiFi & Mesh Networks

Dead zones and dropouts fixed in homes and high-rise units.

Business IT Support

Help for Gold Coast offices, shops and sole traders.

New Computer Setup

Your new PC or laptop set up, with files and programs moved across.

General Troubleshooting

Not sure what's wrong? We'll work it out with you.
View all services →

We cover the Gold Coast from the northern growth corridor down to the NSW border and out to the hinterland. If your suburb isn't listed below, get in touch. We most likely cover it too.

Reviews from Gold Coast customers

Questions

Common questions about us

Are you a franchise?

No. Computers Gold Coast is family-owned and run locally. When you call, you speak to the people who actually do the repairs.

Do you charge a call-out fee?

No. There's no call-out fee anywhere on the Gold Coast. You only pay for the work, and you'll know the price before we start.

Which areas do you cover?

The whole Gold Coast, from Coomera and Helensvale in the north to Coolangatta in the south, and out to Nerang, Mudgeeraba and the hinterland. Remote support is available anywhere with an internet connection.

Can you fix my computer remotely?

Often, yes. Virus removal, slow computers, email problems and software installs can usually be handled remotely. Hardware faults like broken screens or failed drives need hands-on work, either at your place or as a drop-off.

What are your opening hours?

We're open 7am to 10pm, 7 days a week, including weekends and public holidays.

Which brands do you repair?

All the major brands, including Apple, Acer, Asus, Dell, HP, Lenovo, MSI, Samsung, Sony and Toshiba, plus custom-built PCs.

Tell us what your computer is doing

Send us the make, model, your suburb and what's going wrong, and we'll come back to you with a straight answer.

  • ✓ No call-out fee
  • ✓ Price agreed before work starts
  • ✓ Onsite, remote or drop-off
  • ✓ Open 7am to 10pm, 7 days
